claim: The write-through strategy adds or updates data in the cache whenever data is written to the database, which adds latency to the write process. End users are generally more tolerant of latency when updating data than when retrieving data.

evidence.quote: The write-through strategy adds data or updates data in the cache whenever data is written to the database.
